text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After hitching a ride with the fisherman
Hishi Akebono befriended,
we finally set
foot on this... accursed island.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! That sun feels so good! The perfect
day for seaweed
harvesting!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
By the way... That's a lot of luggage,
Trainer! What exactly did you
bring?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
A bunch of water, a fire striker... Ah, you
even brought an
encyclopedia of edible
plants!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I almost forgot how we met. I
found you collapsed in this very
area!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That sure did surprise me. If you hadn't
woken up, I'm not sure what I
would've
done.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Oh, you charmer, you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the goddess you saw is as big
as I am. I guess I'll have to
ask around to
see if anyone else has spotted a giant
goddess.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, put down that stuff and... let's
get going! I wanna harvest
lots and lots of
kombu seaweed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The fisherman said we could grab some
fish while we're at it! Trainer,
you guard
our baskets so the birds don't steal
anything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono takes off for the beaches,
and I'm left in the shade to
watch over our
stuff. Before I know it, two hours have
gone by...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Sorry for the wait!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I found some really big shellfish and fish!
With these, I can make us
some lunch!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's what I brought this big earthen pot
for! I'm sure it'll make it
eeextra good!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no, Trainer, you can sit back and relax!
You must be tired, right?
Keeping watch
can really wear you out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Just wait a teeeensy bit longer. A good,
hearty meal will fix you right
up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono quickly begins preparing
our lunch. Looks like there's
nothing for
me to do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I don't exactly want to just stand
around...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grabbing my encyclopedia of plants, I
make my way farther into the
island in
search of ingredients.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I search, I can't seem
to find anything edible...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I did happen upon some mushrooms, but
picking wild mushrooms as
an amateur
would be asking for trouble.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Traaainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
There you are! Thank goodness! What
happened? Did you get lost?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, wait, are you that hungry?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Well, don't you worry! I'm not just making
hot pot. I'm making some
skewers and
grilled fish too!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
It's almost done, so just wait a liiiittle bit
longer, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A feast fit for a sumo wrestler is laid out
before me. Fish and
vegetable skewers,
hot pot... there's even rice.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every dish makes my taste buds sing with
joy. I know it's far too much
for just the
two of us, but my hands won't stop
reaching for another
helping.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Was it good?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, I'm glad you liked it.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I love seeing you eat with that big smile on
your face. It makes me
feel all warm and
fuzzy.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I sure am glad you became my trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
If you get hungry again, just let me know,
okay? I'll whip up
something in a jiffy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono smiles as she gazes at me,
content with her work.
While she seems to
do it because she enjoys it, I can't help but
want
to return the favor.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right then and there, I decide to treat her
to some good food at the
next
opportunity.
